The coach acts as a control operator, applying influence C to align O and T, ensuring that the team's functional integrity remains intact under adversarial conditions. This is modeled as a dynamic system governed by a feedback loop: C(t) → O(t) → T(t) → U(t), where each layer introduces nonlinearity and stochasticity. The resilience of team spirit and morale (M + S) serves as a critical damping mechanism, preventing catastrophic failure when external stress exceeds internal capacity. Failure modes include: (1) W > V leading to strategic collapse, (2) C < 0 causing organizational disintegration, and (3) M + S < R resulting in motivational breakdown. These dualities form the basis for both GSI’s probabilistic inference engine and GSE’s reactive tactical simulation.
